title: First Law of Thermodynamics Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
Rub your palms and they warm up. Pump a bicycle tyre and the pump gets hot. Steam in a pressure cooker lifts the heavy weight. Work turns into heat and heat turns into work, and one rule keeps the accounts. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 5, Thermodynamics) Aarav pumps his tyre and finds the pump warm, with no flame anywhere.

You will see internal energy U as an energy bank (molecules that move, spin and shake, and bonds), then a gas under a piston on the molecule bench: push the piston and the molecules speed up, add heat and U rises again, let the gas push back and U falls. We set the NCERT sign convention (heat in and work on the system are plus), write the first law ΔU = q + w, derive the work of expansion w = -pex ΔV step by step, show free expansion into a vacuum (w = 0) and work a full example with 1 L bar = 100 J. Then the exam trap (q - w versus q + w), where it is asked, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 52 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students. For NCERT, CBSE, ICSE/ISC, PUC, NEET and JEE students.
